M0.name: M0 · Reproducible foundations
M0.description: A clean clone builds the mobile, web, jobs and Python packages; versioned contracts, database constraints and the official Render local runner are reproducible. No production services are assumed.

M1.name: M1 · Authenticated, resumable collection
M1.description: Real console/mobile identities and owner-bound journals work. Closed MCAP and required sidecars upload directly through the sealed multipart protocol; interruption and account changes preserve ownership and bytes.

M2.name: M2 · Local CPU processing
M2.description: A short real recording passes the official local workflow into mandatory hand inference, bounded immutable outputs and a safe RRD. Fault cases and representative long-input memory/scratch/runtime limits are demonstrated.

M3.name: M3 · Internal review and customer inspection
M3.description: Pipeline recording details lead to all generated clips. Staff approve/assign atomically; datasets contain approved clips only. Authorized customers use the same real viewer without internal data or mutation access.

M4.name: M4 · Bounded cloud CPU canary
M4.description: The same contracts run on Render, R2 and Modal CPU. Real provider failure recovery, direct transfers, measured cost/resource limits, monitoring and an isolated database restore pass.

M5.name: M5 · Collection pilot ready
M5.description: A signed physical-device two-hour capture/upload/process/review flow meets documented limits and repair-footage usefulness criteria. Internal and customer UAT, permission/retention decisions and rollout/rollback evidence are recorded.
